title: Regularisation — Ridge & Lasso on Housing
description: Ridge and Lasso regularisation to fight overfitting on housing.
overview_content:
Lab intro

Scenario: A property-valuation team fits polynomial regression to predict median_house_value from location and dwelling features. High-degree polynomials fit the training set beautifully and the validation set terribly. Your job: diagnose overfitting, then fix it with ridge and lasso regularisation. You will learn: polynomial feature expansion, the bias–variance trade-off, ridge (L2) vs lasso (L1), alpha paths, why standardisation is mandatory before regularisation. Time: ~55 minutes. Level: Intermediate. Needs: pandas + sklearn. Env: 🟢 Colab only.
steps_content:
Exercises (do these!)

Exercise 1 — Locate the overfitting knee

From the degree sweep in section 2, find the degree with the lowest test MAE and the degree where the overfit gap first exceeds $10,000. Expected: best degree = 5; gap first exceeds $10k at degree 7.

Follow-up: How many features does degree 10 create? Check: 1000.

Exercise 2 — Best ridge alpha

Run the ridge grid search and report the best alpha and its CV MAE. Expected: alpha = 100, CV MAE ≈ $56,593.

Follow-up: Does ridge beat unregularised degree-10 OLS on test MAE? Check: yes — $57,194 vs $262,600.

Exercise 3 — Lasso sparsity

Report how many of the 34 degree-3 coefficients are non-zero at lasso's best alpha, and name the top feature. Expected: 32 / 34 non-zero; top feature median_income.

Follow-up: Refit lasso with alpha=10000 — how many survive? Check: 7.
